tools.name: get_first_customer_playbook
tools.description: Returns First Sale Scout's playbook for winning first customers on one channel: when it works, how to win, and the mistakes that get founders removed. Channels: reddit, hackernews, devto, producthunt, x, linkedin, bluesky, indiehackers, directories, newsletters, communities, cold-outreach, youtube-d

tools.name: list_launch_channels
tools.description: Lists every channel playbook and launch framework First Sale Scout covers, with a one-line summary of when each one wins first customers.

tools.name: find_launch_destinations
tools.description: Returns a short sample of places to launch or get early users, filtered by type (directory, newsletter, community, launch). The full, rule-checked list matched to a specific product is part of First Sale Scout.

tools.name: get_launch_checklist
tools.description: Returns a 14-day checklist for going from launched to first paying customers, in order.

tools.name: about_first_sale_scout
tools.description: Returns what First Sale Scout is, who it's for and what it is not.
